name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit tall and secure your thighs under the pads. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Pull the bar toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down; avoid swinging or pulling behind your neck. Return slowly with control.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit upright with a neutral spine and soft knees. Pull the handle toward your lower ribs while drawing your shoulder blades back. Keep your torso steady and extend your arms slowly without rounding your back.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench. Keep your back flat and pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping the elbow close to your body. Lower under control, then switch sides.
video_search: Single Arm Dumbbell Row proper form tutorial

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit tall and hold the close-grip attachment. Pull toward the upper chest with elbows traveling down and slightly forward. Avoid rocking backward or shrugging, then return with control.
video_search: Close Grip Lat Pulldown proper form

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with knees slightly bent and spine neutral. Brace your trunk and pull the bar toward your lower ribs. Keep the bar close and avoid jerking your torso; lower with control.
video_search: Barbell Bent Over Row proper form

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Stand with feet stable and brace your core. Keep your chest supported if the machine provides a pad. Pull the handles toward your torso by driving elbows back, pause briefly, then lower slowly without rounding your back.
video_search: T Bar Row proper form tutorial

name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with feet firmly planted. Pull the weights toward your ribs without lifting your chest off the pad. Lower slowly and keep your neck neutral.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
equipment: Cable machine, straight bar or rope
instructions: Stand facing the cable with a slight hip hinge and soft elbows. Sweep the bar down toward your thighs by engaging your lats. Keep your torso steady and return slowly.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Set assistance to a manageable level and grip the handles securely. Start with shoulders controlled, pull your chest upward, and lower slowly to a comfortable full stretch. Avoid kicking or swinging.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Use a secure overhand grip and brace your body. Pull until your chin clears the bar without craning your neck. Lower under control and avoid excessive swinging. Use assistance if needed.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall with elbows near your sides. Curl the bar without leaning backward or swinging your shoulders. Squeeze near the top, then lower slowly through a comfortable range.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Hold the angled grips with wrists comfortable. Keep your elbows close to your torso and curl smoothly. Avoid using momentum; lower until your arms are nearly straight without forcing the elbows.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a dumbbell in each hand. Curl one weight while keeping the upper arm still. Rotate the palm upward naturally, lower with control, then alternate sides.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline and let your arms hang naturally. Curl without moving the shoulders forward, pause near the top, then lower slowly. Use a lighter load if you cannot control the lowering phase.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other. Keep wrists neutral and elbows near your sides as you curl. Avoid rocking and lower in a controlled manner.

name: Preacher Curl
equipment: Preacher bench, EZ bar or dumbbells
instructions: Position your upper arms on the preacher pad and keep them supported. Curl without lifting your elbows from the pad. Lower slowly and avoid forcing the elbow joint into a hard lockout.

name: Cable Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand stable with elbows tucked and cable tension maintained. Curl the handle toward your shoulders without swaying. Lower slowly while keeping your wrists comfortable.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit with legs apart and brace your upper arm against the inside of your thigh. Curl the dumbbell without swinging, squeeze gently, then lower with control. Repeat for the other arm.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set your feet firmly and retract your shoulder blades against the bench. Unrack with control, lower the bar toward mid-chest, and press upward without bouncing. Use safeties or a spotter for heavy sets.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set a modest incline and keep your shoulder blades stable. Lower dumbbells toward the upper chest with elbows at a comfortable angle, then press up without clanking the weights together.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles align around mid-chest. Keep your back supported and wrists stacked over elbows. Press smoothly and return without letting the stack slam.

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set the pulleys at a comfortable height and stand in a split stance. Keep a soft bend in the elbows and bring your arms together in an arc. Avoid overstretching the shoulders and return slowly.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest by bending your elbows at a comfortable angle, then push the floor away. Elevate your hands if needed to maintain good form.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows or hands align comfortably with chest height. Bring the pads together without shrugging, pause, then open slowly only as far as your shoulders tolerate.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit tall with dumbbells near shoulder height. Brace your core and press overhead along a comfortable path. Avoid excessive back arching; lower slowly and stop if you feel sharp pain.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with soft elbows. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to a comfortable height, keeping shoulders away from your ears. Lower slowly and use a load that avoids swinging.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge slightly at the hips or use a reverse pec deck. Sweep your arms outward with soft elbows and avoid shrugging. Return slowly while maintaining a stable torso.

name: Face Pull
target_muscles: Rear delts, external rotators, upper back
instructions: Set the rope around face height. Pull toward your forehead with elbows out and thumbs moving back, keeping ribs down. Use moderate weight and avoid leaning your body backward.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles start around shoulder level. Keep your back against the pad, press smoothly overhead, and return without bouncing or locking forcefully.

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Keep elbows close to your sides and shoulders relaxed. Extend your arms by moving at the elbows, separate the rope slightly at the bottom, then return slowly without letting elbows drift forward.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Keep ribs down and elbows pointing forward comfortably. Bend the elbows to lower the weight behind your head, then extend smoothly. Choose a load that does not strain your shoulders or elbows.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
instructions: Hinge slightly with upper arm held close to your side. Straighten the elbow without swinging the shoulder, pause briefly, and return with control.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold the bar above your shoulders. Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward a comfortable point near your forehead or behind the head, then extend. Use a spotter and controllable load.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench with palms upward. Let wrists extend slightly, then curl the hands upward. Keep the movement controlled and use a light weight.

name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Use an overhand grip and keep wrists neutral. Curl by bending the elbows while keeping upper arms steady. Avoid wrist discomfort or swinging the body.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar securely across your upper back and brace your trunk. Sit down between your hips while keeping feet planted and knees tracking comfortably over toes. Use a depth you can control and set safety arms when available.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Set your feet about shoulder-width on the platform. Lower the sled only as far as your hips stay supported, then press through your feet without forcefully locking your knees.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the weights close to your legs. Push your hips backward with knees slightly bent and a neutral spine, stopping when you feel a hamstring stretch. Drive hips forward to stand without leaning back.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Align the machine pivot with your knee and position the pad above your ankles. Extend your knees smoothly, pause, and lower under control. Use a pain-free range.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the machine so the knee aligns with the pivot and pads are secure. Curl your heels down and back, pause, then return slowly without letting the stack slam.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Take a controlled step forward and lower until both knees bend comfortably. Keep the front foot stable and torso upright, then push through the front foot to step through. Use bodyweight until balance is solid.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet supported and heels free if using a step. Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower through a comfortable stretch. Avoid bouncing.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Place the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad across your lower thighs. Lower your heels comfortably, then raise them as high as you can control. Pause briefly at both ends.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing the cable with rope near your head. Curl your ribs toward your pelvis by flexing the trunk, not by pulling only with your arms. Return slowly without letting the stack yank you up.

name: Plank
instructions: Place elbows under shoulders and extend your legs. Keep a straight line from head to heels, brace your abdomen, and breathe steadily. End the set when your hips sag or rise.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang securely or use a captain's chair. Brace your trunk and bring knees upward without excessive swinging. Lower slowly and stop if your grip or shoulders become uncomfortable.

name: Treadmill Walk
instructions: Choose a comfortable speed and incline. Stand tall, use a natural stride, and increase intensity gradually. Use the safety clip where available and stop if you feel unwell.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee remains slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke. Start with an easy pace, maintain steady breathing, and increase resistance gradually.

name: Burpee
instructions: Move between a squat, plank, and standing position at a pace you can control. Step your feet back instead of jumping if needed. Prioritize a stable trunk and comfortable wrist and shoulder positions.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Support your upper back on a stable bench with feet planted. Drive through the feet and extend your hips until your torso is roughly level, avoiding over-arching the lower back. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell close to your chest. Sit down between your hips while keeping your chest stable and feet planted. Stand by pushing through the floor; choose a comfortable depth.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall with weights at your sides. Raise your shoulders straight upward without rolling them, pause briefly, then lower slowly. Keep your neck relaxed and avoid jerking.
